title: FBSI: Face-Based Soft-Intersection particle-to-cell volume mapping (reference implementation in Python and C++)
description:
Reference implementation of the Face-Based Soft-Intersection (FBSI) method for computing the fraction of each particle's volume inside each computational cell in Lagrangian–Eulerian (CFD–DEM) simulations.

FBSI represents each cell as the intersection of soft half-spaces defined by its face normals. The resulting anisotropic shape factor follows the real cell geometry, needs no tuning parameters, conserves particle volume exactly and varies smoothly as particles move. The repository contains readable Python and header-only C++ implementations, tests, examples and a guide for integrating the method into existing solvers.

If you use this software, please cite the paper: A. Kianimoqadam, A. J. Schrader, An anisotropic, Face-Based Soft-Intersection method for robust Lagrangian–Eulerian coupling, Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 461 (2026) 119161. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cma.2026.119161
